title: bug: mech_hmac_output_size()==0 not validated in C_Sign HMAC path
description: C_Sign() calls mech_hmac_output_size(s->sign_mech) and stores the result in out_size without checking if it is 0. If s->sign_mech is corrupted or contains an unknown mechanism value (which should have been rejected in C_SignInit but can occur via memory corruption), the size-query returns 0 to the caller. Caller then allocates 0 bytes, calls C_Sign again, and the HMAC write corrupts adjacent memory. Fix: if out_size == 0, clear sign_active and return CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID.
